_meta.source: Hand-authored for this repo (2026-08-08) from the author's own scenario specification -- the sixth evaluation scenario, the second of the two the abstract previously listed as planned. Not transcribed from an external assignment or authoritative report; same provenance caveat as smart_home and family_location.
_meta.purpose: A wearable with GPS plus a companion app: the user logs calorie intake and weight, the device streams exercise and location telemetry, and an analytics service infers health conditions (eating-disorder or diabetes indicators) and daily routines from data queried across sessions. Everything is hosted at a third-party cloud provider. Special-category health inference and cross-session location linkability are the privacy core. All flows Process-mediated so every interaction is reachable with no mapping-table caveats.

flows.description: Wearing the device continuously captures sensor telemetry (heart rate, step counts, GPS position, timestamps)
Device syncs sensor batches to the companion app (exercise sessions, GPS traces, device id, timestamps)
User manually logs calorie intake, meals, and weight entries in the companion app
App writes health logs (calorie intake, weight history, exercise sessions) to the health log store
App writes GPS location traces with timestamps to the location history store
Analytics service reads calorie, weight, and exercise logs across sessions for health-condition analysis
Analytics service queries location history across sessions to derive daily routine and movement patterns
Analytics returns inferred insights to the app (health-condition risk indicators, routine summaries, trend flags)
App dashboard displays trends and inferred condition indicators (eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals) to the user
Analytics data, models, and the full health and location dataset are hosted and replicated at the third-party cloud provider
